description: Write the user's Daily Briefing now and email it to them, when they ask for it: 'send me my daily briefing', 'brief me', 'email me my briefing'. It covers what is new since the last briefing they were sent, and is sent even if the daily email is turned off. Queues the work and returns; the email arrives in a minute or two, so say it is on its way, not that it arrived. Pass focus only when they name a topic to lead with.

focus.description: A topic the briefing should lead with, in the user's words.

name: send_daily_briefing
title: Send my Daily Briefing
